data.one_liner: Pixel art icon font for Flutter providing 1,036 free pixel‑style icons.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles a font and a generated IconData class so you can use pixel‑art icons just like the built‑in Icons. Icons are accessed via the Pixel class (e.g., Pixel.android).
use_when: You need a ready‑made set of pixel‑style icons without adding image assets
You want a drop‑in replacement for Icons with a consistent retro look
avoid_when: You require custom or brand‑specific icons not in the set
You need scalable vector icons that aren’t limited to a 24×24 pixel grid
strengths: Zero asset management – icons are in a font
Simple API identical to the standard Icons class
Automatically generated and kept in sync with upstream
weaknesses: Fixed icon set – cannot add your own without forking
No built‑in theming beyond color and size
data.setup_notes: Add pixelarticons to pubspec.yaml and import 'package:pixelarticons/pixelarticons.dart'.
